# yottabot_llm_gateway (Resource)

A configured route to an upstream inference provider. This is gateway configuration only — the models reachable through it are a separate concern.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Gateway name.
- `upstream_provider` (String) The upstream inference provider: `anthropic`, `openai`, `bedrock`, `vertex`, `openai_compatible`, or `local`.

Named `upstream_provider` rather than `provider` because Terraform reserves `provider` as a meta-argument, and `vendor` on this resource already means something else — the gateway's own owner.

**Changing this forces replacement.** The API has no update path for it: a different upstream is a different gateway.

### Optional

- `auth_mode` (String) How the gateway authenticates upstream: `api_key`, `iam_role`, `oauth`, or `none`.
- `budget_policy` (String) What happens when the budget is reached: `warn`, `require_approval`, `deny`, or `none`.
- `credential_ref` (String) Reference to a stored credential. A reference only — never put a secret value here; it would land in Terraform state.
- `description` (String) Free-text description. Removing it from config clears it.
- `endpoint` (String) Gateway URL. Removing it from config clears it.
- `monthly_budget_cents` (Number) Monthly spend cap, in cents.
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Requests per minute allowed through this gateway.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `draft`, `available`, `unavailable`, or `deprecated`. Registry lifecycle, **not** operational health — see `health_status`.
- `supports_json_mode` (Boolean) Whether the gateway supports JSON mode. Defaults to `true`.
- `supports_streaming` (Boolean) Whether the gateway supports streaming responses. Defaults to `true`.
- `supports_tool_calls` (Boolean) Whether the gateway supports tool calls. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_id` (String) Catalog row this gateway was installed from, if any.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Creator's user UUID.
- `health_status` (String) Operational health, computed from live checks. Separate from `status`.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID. This is the import id.
- `is_managed_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the Yotta-managed default gateway.
- `last_checked_at` (String) Last health check timestamp.
- `last_error` (String) Last error seen, if any.
- `last_invoked_at` (String) Last invocation timestamp.
- `models_count` (Number) Number of models reachable through this gateway.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `vendor` (String) The gateway's owner/implementer — `YottaBot` for the managed default. Distinct from `upstream_provider`, which is the service it calls.
